children: BancFirst acquired SpiritBank, an Oklahoma community bank with approximately $866.8 million in total assets.
BancFirst completed the acquisition of SpiritBank on October 22, 2026.
SpiritBank had approximately $584.6 million in loans and $776.4 million in deposits.
SpiritBank had six locations: four in Tulsa, one in Sapulpa and one in Bristow, Oklahoma.
SpiritBank was merged into BancFirst upon acquisition.
